says: The fetcher patch makes the server overload fail typed, so Alchemy's toHttpClient, which squashes that cause, now puts the HttpServerError wrapper in its TransportError's cause instead of the platform's rejection, a change beyond the proved gap (0054).
proof: Patched src/Fetcher.ts: the server overload now maps a rejection to `new HttpServerError({ reason: new InternalError({ ..., cause: error.cause }) })`; toHttpClient (src/Fetcher.ts:211, its catchCause at :234-240) sets `cause: ... squashed` where `squashed = Cause.squash(cause)`, which was the raw rejection when it was a defect and is now the HttpServerError.
cost: None in next/ today, since no file uses toHttpClient, the Worker loopback or the container fetcher. An upstream fix built from this patch, or a later user of toHttpClient here, gets a wrapped cause.
